scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Head to the Archer Guild ( pay_arche 145, 164) in the Archer Village north of Payon .
1.short_en: Go to the Archer Guild: pay_arche 145, 164.
1.full_ru: Отправляйтесь в Archer Guild (pay_arche 145, 164), в Archer Village к северу от Payon.
1.full_en: Head to the Archer Guild ( pay_arche 145, 164) in the Archer Village north of Payon .

2.original_instruction: Talk to the Archer Guildsman (payon_in02 64,71). You will be told to collect different type of Trunks for a minimum of 25 points. There are 4 types of Trunks: | Note : Trunks can be obtained by the monster Willow , found near Payon on some maps (a good start is one east of Payon). Beware of Elder Willows , as they look similar but are strong at this point. Time can be saved by leveling off of Willow from 10/8 to 12/10 or so because the Trunks are needed anyway.
2.short_ru: У Archer Guildsman (payon_in02 64,71) соберите Trunks минимум на 25 очков.
2.short_en: For Archer Guildsman (payon_in02 64,71), collect Trunks worth at least 25 points.
2.full_ru: Поговорите с Archer Guildsman (payon_in02 64,71). Нужно собрать Trunks разных типов на минимум 25 очков. Всего есть 4 типа Trunks. Примечание: их можно добыть с Willow рядом с Payon; начните с карты к востоку от Payon. Остерегайтесь Elder Willows: они похожи, но пока слишком сильны. Для экономии времени можно сражаться с Willow примерно с 10/8 до 12/10, поскольку Trunks всё равно понадобятся. Очки за предмет: Trunk — 1; Barren Trunk — 2; Solid Trunk — 3; Fine-grained Trunk — 5.

reviews.detail: The legacy extractor omitted the four-row point table. Pinned HTML restores values 1/2/3/5; any eligible mix must total at least 25. No fixed trunk count, all-four-types cost or Willow kill quota is invented.
The 10/8 to 12/10 range is a suggested leveling tactic, not a base/job eligibility requirement. Job Level 10 is the source header gate.
Bow 1702 and Arrows 1750 are exact own-guide links; reward quantities remain NULL. Original archive rows and stable IDs are preserved.
